svg.aria-label: Two real six-hour ESA telemetry windows, both labelled anomalies. Top: channel 45 on 2007-09-25, one sharp isolated spike, correctly flagged anomalous. Bottom: channel 45 on 2009-10-13, five hours of sustained oscillation with lower standard deviation, missed and called nominal.
svg.text: What the model catches, and what it misses
Two real 6-hour windows from the held-out set. Both are ESA-labelled anomalies; the shaded span is the labelled interval.
ESA category: Anomaly · truth: anomalous · window std 0.0084
ESA category: Anomaly · truth: anomalous · window std 0.0054
The missed window is the steadier of the two — std 0.0054 against 0.0084. Leaning on variance is what gives 0.837 precision and only 0.643 recall.
